summary: Verified (1) VMs run through proxy: clicking VM5 tile in /window.html -> vms.html frame -> vm-apponfly launches Scramjet-proxied navigation (address bar contains apponfly, scramjet frame url present, overlay NOT used). (2) OS-word censoring: /pages/vms.html visible innerText contains W1nd0ws / L1nux (as CSS-uppercased L1NUX) / Ubun7u and does NOT contain plain 'windows', 'linux', 'ubuntu' (case-insensitive). (3) Cloak regression: classroom cloak sets title 'Home' & localStorage 'classroom'; none cloak restores 'Flint'; reload persists 'Flint'.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: 'L1nux' string in source is rendered as 'L1NUX' at runtime due to CSS text-transform:uppercase on .tag. Case-sensitive test looking for exact 'L1nux' in innerText would fail; case-insensitive matches which satisfies the intent (leetspeak visible, no plain OS names). Not a bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three verification items pass. AppOnFly proxy nav observed as address bar 'https://htmlgw3.apponfly.com/rdp/...' and a /scramjet/https%3A%2F%2Fhtmlgw3.apponfly.com iframe. Cloak flows behave per spec.
